footer.about: Since 2009 ARCHTRADE has been making furniture built to outlast trends. We work in solid timber and natural textiles, take made-to-measure commissions, and supply residential and commercial projects across Georgia.

home.featuredDescription: A cross-section of what we hold and what we specify most often. Ask about any of it and the reply comes the same day.
home.why1Body: Oak, walnut and beech from managed forests, finished in natural oil rather than lacquer — so a scratch can be sanded out instead of replaced.
home.why2Body: Nearly everything in the catalogue can be rebuilt to your dimensions and your finish. Send us the room and we will send back a drawing.
home.why3Body: Our own crew delivers anywhere in Georgia, carries it in, assembles it, and takes the packaging away again.
home.why4Body: Every frame and every mechanism is covered for five years. Upholstery and finishes are covered for two.
home.contactTitle: Send us the floor and the programme
home.contactBody: Nothing on this site carries a price, because no two schedules are the same. Send the drawing, the quantities and the handover date, and a costed specification usually follows within the day.
home.groupEmpty: This part of the catalogue has not been set up yet.
home.catalogueDescription: Furniture, lighting, acoustics and public seating — from one supplier, under one contract.

contact.floatingBody: Whichever is easiest. Someone from the showroom answers during working hours.
contact.generalMessage: Hello ARCHTRADE, I have a question about your furniture.
contact.inquiryMessage: Hello ARCHTRADE, I would like to ask about “{{product}}”. {{url}}
contact.title: Talk to someone who knows the stock.
contact.description: The showroom on Vazha-Pshavela answers during working hours. For a project enquiry, the more you can tell us about the floor and the programme, the more useful the first reply will be.
contact.channelsBody: All four go to the same team. WhatsApp is usually quickest; email is best if you have drawings or a schedule to attach.
contact.tradeNote: Architects, contractors and procurement teams: ask for trade terms and a sample box, and we will send both with the specification.
contact.mapTitle: Map of the ARCHTRADE showroom on Vazha-Pshavela Avenue, Tbilisi

catalog.title: Every piece we supply, in one place.
catalog.description: Filter by setting or search by name, material or dimension. Nothing here carries a price — each piece is quoted against a real drawing and a real quantity, so ask and we will come back the same day.
catalog.noResultsBody: Try a shorter search, or clear the filters to see the whole catalogue.

category.notFoundTitle: We could not find that category
category.notFoundBody: It may have been renamed, or taken out of the catalog. Everything else is still here.
category.emptyBody: These pieces have not been photographed yet. Ask us and we will send what is available.

product.inquiryBody: Send us this piece and we will come back with a price, the lead time, and the finishes it can be made in.
product.inquiryNote: We usually reply within a few hours during working hours.
product.relatedDescription: Pieces that sit naturally alongside this one.
product.notFoundTitle: We could not find that piece
product.notFoundBody: It may have been renamed, or withdrawn from the catalog. Everything else is still here.

state.errorBody: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
state.emptyBody: No products have been added to this section yet.
state.placeholderBody: This page is being written. The catalogue and our contact details are ready in the meantime.
state.notFoundTitle: We could not find that page
state.notFoundBody: The address may be mistyped, or the page may have moved. Everything else is still here.
state.notConfiguredBody: Create a .env file with VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, then restart the dev server.
state.notConfiguredDeployed: This deployment was built without the Supabase keys. In Vercel, add VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY under Settings → Environment Variables with the Preview environment ticked, then redeploy — variables are read at build time, not at page load.

admin.loginHelp: Accounts are created by the site administrator. If you cannot sign in, ask them to check your account.
admin.notAdminTitle: This account cannot edit the catalog
admin.notAdminBody: You are signed in, but this account is not on the administrator list. Ask the site administrator to add it, then sign in again.
admin.productsSubtitle: Everything in the catalog. Changes appear on the website immediately.
admin.noProducts: No products yet. Use the Add new product button to create the first one.
admin.pickSubcategory: {{name}} holds subcategories, so it cannot hold a product itself. Choose one of the subcategories above.
admin.priceHint: For your reference only. The website always shows Price on request.
admin.dimensionsHint: Written however it reads best, e.g. W 220 x D 95 x H 75 cm.
admin.featuredHint: Featured pieces appear in the selection on the home page.
admin.imageLimits: JPG, PNG, WEBP or AVIF. Up to {{max}} each.
admin.imageWrongType: {{name}} is not a picture file. Use JPG, PNG, WEBP or AVIF.
admin.imageTooBig: {{name}} is {{size}}, which is over the {{max}} limit. Please use a smaller version.
admin.imageNoBucket: Photo storage has not been set up yet. Ask the site administrator to run the admin setup file.
admin.imageNotPermitted: This account is not allowed to upload photographs.
admin.imageFailed: The photograph could not be uploaded. {{message}}
admin.errorBadCredentials: That email and password do not match an account.
admin.errorNotConfirmed: This account has not been confirmed yet. Ask the site administrator to confirm it.
admin.errorSetupMissing: The database has not been set up for editing yet. Ask the site administrator to run the admin setup file.
admin.errorNotPermitted: This account is not allowed to make changes. Ask the site administrator to add it to the administrator list.
admin.errorDuplicate: A product with this name already exists. Try a slightly different name.
admin.errorDuplicateCategory: A category with this name already exists.
admin.idleBody_one: Nothing has happened here for a while. You will be signed out in {{count}} second.
admin.idleBody_other: Nothing has happened here for a while. You will be signed out in {{count}} seconds.
admin.idleExpired: Session expired due to inactivity. Please sign in again.
admin.confirmArchive: Archive {{name}}? It comes off the website straight away and waits here for {{days}} days, so it can be put back. After that it is deleted for good, photographs included.
admin.adminsOnlyBody: Managing accounts is limited to administrators. You can still add, edit and archive pieces in the catalog.
admin.staffSubtitle: Everyone who can sign in here. Administrators can do everything, including deleting pieces and managing this list. Operators can add, edit and archive pieces, which covers everyday catalog work.
admin.staffAddHint: The person is signed in from the moment you press the button — there is no confirmation email. Tell them the password yourself, and ask them to change it once they are in.
admin.staffCreated: The account was created and added to the list below.
admin.staffFunctionMissing: Creating accounts is not switched on for this project yet. The site administrator needs to deploy the admin-users function — see supabase-rbac.sql. Until then, create the account in the Supabase dashboard under Authentication, then add it here.
admin.staffConfirmRemove: Remove {{name}}? They lose access to the dashboard immediately. Their sign-in account is not deleted.
admin.noArchived: Nothing is archived. A piece taken off the site waits here for {{days}} days, and can be put back at any time in that window.
admin.catTreeSubtitle: Drag order, nesting and visibility. The site navigation follows this tree exactly — a change here is live on the next page load.
admin.catAddingTop: New top-level section. A section holds subcategories, not products — save it and you can add its subcategories straight away.
admin.catAddingUnder: Adding inside {{name}}. Products belong in subcategories like these, not in the section above them.
admin.catEmptyHint: No products in this branch, so it stays out of the navigation until there are.
admin.catSlugFromEnglish: The web address is built from this title.
admin.catDeleteBody: {{name}} will be removed for good. If it still holds products or subcategories, the database will refuse.
admin.catDeleteBlockedChildren: This category still has subcategories. Move or delete them first.
admin.catDeleteBlockedProducts: This category still holds products. Move them to another category first.
admin.brandsSubtitle: The manufacturer list the site reads. A website or description added here shows on the brands page straight away.
admin.brandDeleteBody: {{name}} will be removed for good. If any product still names it, the database will refuse.
admin.brandDeleteBlocked: Products still name this brand. Move them to another one first.
admin.brandErrorDuplicate: A brand with that slug already exists. Change the name or the slug.
admin.brandCountryHint: Two-letter code, for example IT or DK.
admin.brandWebsiteHint: The official address the manufacturer itself uses.
admin.brandEnableHint: Clear this and the brand leaves the site while everything recorded about it is kept.
admin.slugTitle_notLatin: The page address is built from this title, so write it in Latin letters.
admin.slugTitle_noSlug: No page address can be built from this title. Add at least one Latin letter or number.
admin.slugName_notLatin: The page address is built from this name, so write it in Latin letters.
admin.slugName_noSlug: No page address can be built from this name. Add at least one Latin letter or number.
admin.slugShape: Lower-case Latin letters, numbers and single hyphens, for example herman-miller.

hero.title: Furniture that outlasts the trend
hero.description: We hold the agencies for twenty-nine European and American manufacturers. Their seating, storage, lighting and acoustics go into offices, hotels, embassies and residences across Georgia — specified against the drawing, delivered against the programme.
hero.descriptionShort: Agents for twenty-nine European and American manufacturers. Furniture, lighting and acoustics — from the drawing to the installation.

services.title: Complete furnishing for commercial and architectural interiors
services.description: Furniture, lighting and acoustic systems from European manufacturers, specified to the project.
services.fitOutBody: Whole floors quoted, warehoused and installed against your programme. One order, one delivery schedule, one snag list.
services.workplaceBody: Task seating, bench desking, storage walls and meeting tables, specified for eight-hour days and a ten-year life rather than for a photograph.
services.lightingBody: Decorative and technical fittings together — from UGR<19 office luminaires to the pendant a lobby is remembered by.
services.acousticsBody: Pods, baffles, panels and desk screens. The line most often cut from a budget and most often complained about six months after handover.

brands.title: The manufacturers behind the specification.
brands.description: Twenty-nine houses, each reviewed on product and on service before it goes into a building. Filter by setting to see who covers what.

about.title: The direct representative of European brands in Georgia
about.statement: We manage the whole of supply — from the manufacturer to installation on site. International standards of quality, held to the budget and to the programme.
about.briefBody: The drawings, the headcount, the budget and the handover date — including the constraints nobody put in writing.
about.specifyBody: A named schedule: house, model, finish, fabric and quantity, with samples in your hands before anything is ordered.
about.supplyBody: Ordered from the factory, tracked through transit and held in our warehouse until the floor is ready to receive it.
about.installBody: Delivered, built and placed to the layout, with snagging closed and the warranty documents a facilities team actually needs.

projects.title: Rooms that had to work on the first morning.
projects.description: Ministries, bank headquarters, hotels and head offices across Georgia and the region — furnished, lit and quietened by us.

quote.title: Request a spec sheet
quote.description: Tell us the project and we will send the full specification, lead times and trade terms for this piece. No price is shown on this site — every quotation is written against a real drawing and a real quantity.
quote.notesPlaceholder: Building, floor area, programme dates, anything that shapes the specification
quote.placeholderNotice: This form is not connected yet. Until it is, the buttons below open your email or Messenger with the same details filled in.

clients.title: Our partners
clients.description: A trusted partner on large private and public projects.
clients.note: Names are listed with our clients' permission. Full references and site visits can be arranged on request.

pages.aboutTitle: A furniture house, not a reseller.
pages.aboutDescription: archtrade holds the agencies, the sample library, the warehouse and the fitting crew in one company. The people who write the specification are the people who answer for it on site.
pages.servicesTitle: Everything between an empty floor and a room in use.
pages.servicesDescription: Furniture, lighting and acoustics, offered separately or as one supply package. Most clients take more than one, which is where the value is: nobody is left arguing about whose delivery is late.
pages.collectionsTitle: What we furnish, setting by setting.
pages.collectionsDescription: We represent a selected group of manufacturers rather than a catalogue of everything. Each is reviewed on product and on service before we put them into a building.

collections.lightingBody: Decorative and technical together: pendants, linear profiles, track and recessed office luminaires from UGR<19 upward.
collections.acousticsBody: Pods, baffles, panels and desk screens — the discipline that decides whether an open floor is usable or merely open.
collections.officeBody: Task seating, bench desking, storage walls and meeting tables — the furniture a floor is judged on after the first month, not the first week.
collections.hospitalityBody: Lobby seating, restaurant chairs, banquettes and auditorium systems, rated for contract use and specified in fabrics a hotel can actually clean.
collections.residentialBody: Danish and Spanish design houses for apartments, villas and executive floors — the pieces people choose to keep when they move.
collections.outdoorBody: Terraces, roof bars and courtyards. Aluminium, teak and rope, built for weather and for the wash-down a hotel gives them every morning.

brands.title: International partner brands
brands.description: Twenty-nine European and American manufacturers we represent officially in Georgia. Choose the products for your project.
